استدللت (form X)
# اِسْتَدْلَلْتُ (istadlaltu) /is.tad.lal.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَدَلَّ (istadalla)
# اِسْتَدْلَلْتَ (istadlalta) /is.tad.lal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَدَلَّ (istadalla)
# اِسْتَدْلَلْتِ (istadlalti) /is.tad.lal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَدَلَّ (istadalla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
